# vue3-json-to-excel

> Vue 3 component that exports a JSON object to an Excel (.xlsx) file in the browser, built on SheetJS (xlsx).

Install with `npm i vue vue3-json-to-excel`. `<vue3-json-to-excel :jsonData="{ hello: 'world' }" fileName="report" buttonText="Download" />` renders a link that downloads `report.xlsx`. `jsonData` must be a single object: it becomes one row, with its keys as column headers. The default export also has an `install()` method, so `app.use()` registers it globally.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/Readme.MD): install, usage, props and a full example
- [Component source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/vue3-json-to-excel.vue): props, defaults and the export logic
- [Plugin entry](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/entry.esm.js): default export with install() for app.use()
- [Dev example](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/dev/serve.vue): the local playground that `npm run serve` starts
